limitations: Applies only to weird n=2^k p q with p<q odd primes.
Does not prove existence or infinitude and does not prove Iannucci one-third conjecture.
Unindexed or incompletely accessed primary literature remains a novelty risk.
scientific_integrity: Full universal proof given, binary divisor blocks and packing steps exposed; finite checking corroborative only. No assertion of optimality or independent validation.
title: A two-thirds abundance bound for weird numbers of form \(2^k p q\)
